diabetes.label: diabetes
diabetes.ui_description: This score reflects how your age, BMI, activity level, and dietary patterns compare to a population with similar characteristics. It is not a meal-level score — use the rule-based score above for meal-specific dietary risk.

cvd.label: cvd
cvd.ui_description: This score reflects how your age, BMI, activity level, and dietary patterns compare to a population with known cardiovascular risk markers. It is not a meal-level score — use the rule-based score above for meal-specific dietary risk.
